If the Cmd + I shortcut of the Ask AI modal conflicts with your Studio, you can disable it using this.

## CLI flag

Use `--disable-ask-ai` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                             | Flag               |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                               | `--disable-ask-ai` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                               | `--disable-ask-ai` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                                 | `--disable-ask-ai` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)                   | `--disable-ask-ai` |
| [`remotion bundle`](/docs/cli/bundle)                               | `--disable-ask-ai` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)                         | `--disable-ask-ai` |
| [`remotion lambda sites create`](/docs/lambda/cli/sites/create)     | `--disable-ask-ai` |
| [`remotion cloudrun sites create`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/sites/create) | `--disable-ask-ai` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`bundle()`](/docs/bundle#askaienabled)
- [`deploySite()`](/docs/cloudrun/deploysite#askaienabled)
- [`deploySite()`](/docs/lambda/deploysite#askaienabled)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setAskAIEnabled(false);
```
